public interface ObservableAttribute
Interface specification for an observable attribute, i.e. an SysMLAttributeType that is observable by AttributeObserver implementations. Similar to the familiar Observer/Observable pattern, the ObservableAttribute implementation maintains a list of AttributeObservers and notifies them when the observed attribute changes. All SysMLAttributeTypes implement this interface making them observable for use as end values in "binding connectors" as well as other change-notification applications.

  • Method Details

    • addAttributeObserver

      void addAttributeObserver(AttributeObserver observer)
      Adds the specified AttributeObserver to list of observers of this value which are to be notified of a change to the attribute.

      Note this method is provided to enable model execution. It is not part of the SysML standard. To the extent the SysML standard does not provide elements for executable modeling per se, SysMLinJava includes various model elements to enable model execution.

      Parameters:
      observer - value observer to be added

    • notifyAttributeObservers

      void notifyAttributeObservers()
      Causes all AttributeObservers in the list of observers to be notified of the change of attribute, i.e. it invokes each of the AttributeObservers attributeChanged() method.

      Note this method is provided to enable model execution. It is not part of the SysML standard. To the extent the SysML standard does not provide elements for executable modeling per se, SysMLinJava includes various model elements to enable model execution.
